devops.code:
# OAuth Migration Phases

## Phase 1: Infrastructure Setup (Month 1-2)
- Set up Auth0 tenant
- Configure applications and APIs
- Implement authentication rules
- Set up monitoring and logging

## Phase 2: Pilot Applications (Month 3-4)
- Migrate 5 low-risk applications
- Validate OAuth flow
- Test SSO functionality
- Train development teams

## Phase 3: Internal Applications (Month 5-8)
- Migrate 50+ internal applications
- Implement role-based access control
- Set up MFA for sensitive apps
- Monitor adoption and issues

## Phase 4: External Applications (Month 9-11)
- Migrate customer-facing applications
- Implement social login
- Set up user migration
- Performance optimization

## Phase 5: Legacy Decommission (Month 12)
- Sunset old authentication systems
- Final data migration
- Security audit
- Documentation and training

## Rollback Plan
- Maintain parallel authentication systems
- Feature flags for gradual rollout
- Database replication for user data
- 24/7 support during migration
